text:
Alex Chen: quick sync — proposing we compress the handshake/probe between hosted/dedicated/private adapters to a tiny, stable schema so runtime code can fast-path decisions. idea: single JSON probe with capability flags + small auth shape descriptor.

Priya Rao: curious — what fields are you thinking? need to avoid leaking tenant metadata in hosted probes. also: any auth descriptors must be intentionally vague (no keys).

Alex Chen: agree on privacy. prototype: `{"capabilities":["kvcache","streaming","batching"], "versions":{"kvcache":"v1"}, "auth_shape":"token-hmac-v1"}` — where `auth_shape` is just an enum describing what auth exchange looks like, not credentials.

Samir Patel: runtime note: if probe is tiny we can make probe-first async and cache results per runtime instance. important for cold-starts. also we need an explicit TTL and a probe-failure fallback code (e.g., 402 fallback: compatibility).

Marta Gomez: +1. we should also define a minimal failure matrix so fallback to hosted/dedicated variants is deterministic. suggest codes: OK, PARTIAL, INCOMPATIBLE, AUTH_UNKNOWN.

Priya Rao: PARTIAL needs semantics — e.g., supports kvcache but not streaming. clients should be able to query which feature to degrade gracefully. keep it machine-readable.

Alex Chen: agreed. here's a tiny example response we can standardize:
```
{
  "status":"PARTIAL",
  "capabilities":["kvcache"],
  "versions":{"kvcache":"v1"},
  "auth_shape":"token-hmac-v1",
  "ttl_seconds":300
}
```

Samir Patel: for Dedicated we can enrich with `latency_hint_ms` and `max_concurrent` but those should be optional fields so hosted probes remain minimal.

Marta Gomez: rollout plan suggestion: land schema as feature-flagged in adapter libs, run canary in a single region for 48h, exercise fallbacks with a loadtest that flips status codes. create a short e2e test that asserts no tenant identifiers in response.

infra-bot: deploy-check — canary cluster (infra-canary-3) has capacity for a 48h probe-schema experiment starting 2026-03-25. :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: next actions: (1) Priya to draft privacy constraints for probe payload (2) Samir to add caching/ttl/failure codes to runtime stub (3) Marta to own canary plan + tests. I'll open a tiny RFC and attach the example schema. tagging @here for visibility :eyes:

Priya Rao: ack, will drop a short doc with prohibited fields and example responses.

Samir Patel: ack — I'll prototype the runtime cache + TTL by EOD Friday.

Marta Gomez: ack — will write the canary playbook and test harness next sprint.

Alex Chen: thanks all — logging as action items in the RFC.
